name: 通話の出力音量を調整するバー
prompt:
Create a crisp, flat Japanese call-volume control component at exactly 390×116. Use the 390×116 native preview as the exact source of truth for wording, control state, proportions, and geometry. Use the original screenshot crop only to verify speaker-icon shape and slider anatomy. Keep the compact Meiryo-based style.

Follow the current white-surface design system and user direction: no mint or pastel tint fills. Page background and control card are pure white #FFFFFF; card has a fine neutral #E8ECE9 outline and 12px corners. Keep the slider rail neutral #E8ECE9. The filled green volume segment is a meaningful control value, not a surface tint; use a restrained solid forest green #1F6444. The knob stays white with a thin neutral #E8ECE9 outline and a very soft neutral edge shadow. Render both outline speaker icons consistently in slate #526173. No gradient or colored glow on ordinary surfaces.

Preserve the exact Japanese text 音量 at x30 y18, 330×24, Meiryo Bold 14px, #1D1D1D. Preserve the 390×116 canvas. Card x16 y8, 358×92, radius12. Left speaker icon x32 y59, 24.75×20; slider rail x72 y66, 236×4, radius2; green filled value segment x72 y66, 168×4, radius2; white knob with neutral border x230 y56, 24×24; right speaker icon x336 y59, 24.75×20. Keep the slider position and fill amount exact.

Do not add a hyperlink, labels, numbers, mute icon, extra buttons, or other content. Keep icon outline geometry faithful, text readable, control centered and aligned, and no device frame.
reviewNotes: White neutral card, slate icons, white knob, and meaningful green slider value are correct. Needs-correction: card is about 16px too short and 10px too low; slider knob and title are mildly displaced after normalization.
